title: Fantastic Four #543 Marvel 2007 Civil War Epilogue 45th Anniversary McDuffie
condition_description: Clean, bright covers with light handling wear. See photos.
description:
Fantastic Four #543 (Marvel, May 2007). Civil War Epilogue and 45th anniversary issue, birthday cake cover by Adi Granov. Credits on cover: McDuffie, McKone, Lee, Dragotta, Allred, Pope. Direct Edition, $3.99 cover price.

Back cover: Yu-Gi-Oh! GX Duelist Pack ad.

Condition: clean, bright covers with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
